contexts.text: Love and faith can never be separated...
The Lord then miraculously separated the intellectual proprium from the corrupt voluntary proprium... AC 2053:end. AC 2069:end. AC 2256:3.
The antediluvians are (thus) separated from the rest of the Hells...
Separate, I pray, from me () = that the good cannot appear unless what is discordant becomes null. Explained. AC 1582.
The separation is not separation, but quiescence. With no man, except the Lord, can the evil in the external man be separated... But it seems to be separated when it is quiescent...
Good must be separated from evil before (anyone can be thrust down into Hell).
He who has led an evil life... successively separates himself from the Angels...
They who separate this Trine...
That which is separated from anyone is represented by a rejection as if behind him, Signified, Explained.
Jehovah was... not separate from the Lord, although He is presented as separate...
That good cannot die, because evil can be separated from it. Signified, Explained.

Good and evil are never so commingled that they cannot be separated... In the other life, the Lord separates his evils; (or else) He separates from him what is good... But it is a separation, never a plenary taking away. AC 2284:2.
That the Divine good cannot do this according to truth separated from good. Signified, Explained.
The evil are not damned because Divine good is separated from Divine truth; but because the man separates himself from Divine good.
Unless the evil were separated from the good, they would injure them...
The proceeding Holy... is what separates the evil from the good. Explained.
Those in the good of charity... among the evil, but separated from them. Signified, Explained.
(Three separate gods thought of.)
The Lord cannot be in truth separated from good.
The approach (of the evil there) is precluded by the good being separated from the evil...
The time when the upright are being separated from the evil. Treated of. AC 2407.
That separation precedes Judgment. Illustrated.
Before this is done (it is provided) that with the good evils should be separated; and, with the evil, that goods should be separated...
That all truths were separated from them. Signified, Explained.
With the good (there) evils and falsities are separated... but with the evil, goods and truths are separated... Illustrated.

The reason of the separation of evils and falsities with the good, is that they may not hang between evils and goods, but that through goods they may be elevated into Heaven; and the reason of the separation of goods and truths with the evil, is that they may not... seduce the upright, and that through evils they may secede to the evil... For such is the communication... (there that) unless they were separated there would be innumerable harms, and there would be no consociation... Still, the separation is not a plenary taking away.
That all goods were separated from them. Signified, Explained.
Then the Lord inflows, and separates successively and continuously those things which adhere from hereditary and actual evil.
The separation of the merely human Rational. Signified, Explained. AC 2649. AC 2856.
All things of the first Rational remain, and are separated only from the second Rational; and this miraculously by the Lord.
(The separation of married partners there.)
By the fall... the natural man separated himself from the spiritual.
That all good and truth wherewith evil and falsity is mixed must be separated. Sig and Explained.
That their state was completely separated. Signified, Explained.
The separation of the goods and truths, which had been procured by His own power. Signified, Explained. AC 4026.
After this good has subserved these uses, it is separated. Treated of.

The separation of the good and truth represented by Jacob... from the good signified by Laban Treated of. AC 4063, Explained. AC 4067:end, Explained. AC 4093. AC 4105, Signified, Explained. AC 4110. AC 4113.
The first state of their separation. Signified, Explained. (Four of these states enumerated.)

When (these Spirits) have performed their use, they are separated (from the man), which separation of them is effected in various ways... The separation of good Spirits is effected when they are not aware of it... The separation of Spirits of a middle sort is effected by many means, until they recede in freedom... Evil spirits also are removed in freedom... they then feel delight in separation... Such is the case with the separation of the Spirits with man when he is being regenerated.
The beginning of the state of separation. Signified, Explained. AC 4120.
The process of this separation is here fully described.
When Societies of Spirits and Angels are adjoined to man by the Lord, and are separated from him. Treated of.
That the separation was made against the will (of mediate good), whereas it ought to be done from freedom. Signified, Explained. AC 4137. AC 4144.
Every man... is first in mediate good, that it may serve to introduce genuine goods and truths; but after it has served this use, it is separated. Explained.
That if the separation were made from the freedom of that good, the affections of truth would be injured. Signified, Explained.
That all things of that good were separated. Signified, Explained.
That after the good represented by Laban was separated from the good represented by Jacob, it came into another state by the separation. Signified, Explained.
That it was not of evil that he (Jacob) had separated himself. Signified, Explained.
When these Spirits are separated from the Society, they are indignant. Signified.
(Change in the representation of a person when he is separated from some other person.) Explained.
Separation relatively to the things of the Church. Signified, Explained.
Evil and falsity are not separated from the Angels.
When life conjoins (the men of the Church) doctrine does not separate them; but if doctrine alone conjoins them... then they separate themselves from each other...
Those who separate the things of faith from those of charity...
This conjunction is profanation... From such, good... and truth... cannot be separated... for things so conjoined can never be separated to eternity, and therefore the deepest Hell awaits them.
He shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats () = the separation of good from evil... See LJ 49.
(The separation signified by the flight of Joseph from Potiphar's wife.) Explained. AC 5010.
Evils are then separated, and are cast out from the centre... Evils are thus separated, but still are retained...
The first agitations [endured by]. Spirits... in order that evils may be separated...
He shut them up in custody = separation from himself.
That they separated from themselves the truth of good... Signified, Explained.
The external appearance that the Internal was as it were separated from them. Signified, Explained.
That this truth cannot be separated from spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
Thus separation from perverted scientifics. Signified, Explained.
This separation is effected by ordination...
Separation as to time. Signified, Explained.
The reason these two were not to be separated, was that Divine truth separated from Divine good condemns everyone.

It seemed as if these Spirits could scarcely he separated from me. I... told them they ought to be separated; but... when they separated themselves a little... I could not think... This showed how loves conjoin. Explained.

As (Spirits connected with me by only slight affections) were separated, they appeared to be removed to a distance towards the left in front; and the separation was observed by changes of the state of the affections...
With such (a profaner) good cannot be separated from evil, which, however, are separated (there)...
Such are separated from angelic Society.
The Spirits and Angels from other Earths are all separated from each other according to the Earths... AC 7800, Explained. AC 7801.
From a law of order (good and evil) separate themselves from each other... as Heaven and Hell are separated, so all things thence separate themselves.
The separation, with a man being regenerated, of truth Divine from falsities. Signified, Explained.
The order with the evil who are being condemned, is that of truth Divine separated from Divine good...
The Sensuous and Corporeal separated from the Rational. Treated of.

The heavenly Societies with which such communicate cannot be separated except by degrees... nothing is done violently, but everything in freedom, and therefore those Societies are not sundered from them; but are separated successively...
The separation of the communication with those in good and truth, Signified, Explained. AC 7589. AC 7595. AC 7608. AC 7650.
Enjoyment in a state of separation from the evil who infested. Signified, Explained.
The affection of separation. Signified, Explained.
A state of charity and faith through which there was separation from those in evils and falsities. Signified, Explained.
The people fled = that they were completely separated.
The waters were cleft asunder = separation and removal from truths.
I will flee before Israel = separation from those who are in the good of truth...
Genii are completely separated from those in exterior evil, who are called Spirits. Explained.
After the dismissals of (Zipporah) = the separation (of good) relatively to the state of those of the Spiritual Church. Explained.
The evils with them are then separated, so that they do not appear at all. Signified, Explained.
Lest Jehovah make a breach on them = separation from good. ( = separation from truth and good. AC 8843.)
Truths separated from good (are the laws of order) in Hell.
As soon as they disagree (there) they are separated from each other...
The waters of separation () = purification from evils and falsities through truths and goods from the Word.
The Divine sphere which guards Hell, is a sphere of Divine truth separated from Divine good. Explained.
(The scape-goat) = the separation and casting out in every way of evil from good.
That the evils with man are not altogether separated, but are removed... References. DP 279:2, Explained.
A land of separation () = Hell. Explained.
The belt = a bond, and separation from the external things of the Spiritual Kingdom. Explained.
When the Spirits came, the good were separated from the evil; the good to the right, and the evil to the left; and this at once as of their own accord...
Thus was effected the separation (of hypocrites from that Society).
What therefore God hath joined together, let not man separate (; ) = that good is not to be separated from truth.
Whence it is that Hell has been separated from Heaven. Explained.
Therefore, when these two motions cease in the body, there is at once a separation.
After the separation, the man's spirit remains for a while in the body...
After the first and the second state has been passed through (all there) are separated, so that they do not see each other...
Nevertheless (married partners) are not separated until they enter the second state.
The separation of evil Spirits from good Spirits takes place in this second state... The separation of the good from the evil is effected in various ways, commonly, by...
It is possible for the human race on one Earth to perish, which takes place when it completely separates itself from the Divine. Explained.
On the way, the evil were separated from the good... LJ 51.
Visitation is also the separation of the good from the evil; the good are taken away, and the evil are left behind.
As soon as (the Papists) arrive there... they are completely separated...
The Lord continually disposes that evil be by itself, and good by itself, so that they can be separated. Explained.
Man then commingles good and evil, so that they cannot be separated. Explained.
Preface. In () it treats, first, of the separation of those of the Christian Heaven from the evil.
Until we have sealed the servants of our God... = until those have been separated who are in truths from good. Explained.
Influx from the Inmost Heaven... that the evils and falsities of the Church may be disclosed, and thus the evil be separated from the good. Signified, Explained. AR 676. Signified, Explained.
The Lord as to the Word... from which He effects Judgment, and separates the good from the evil. Signified, Explained.
When the good have been separated from the evil, the evil cast themselves into Hell.

That if the married partners... cannot live together, they separate themselves; sometimes the man from the wife, sometimes the wife from the man, and sometimes each from the other. Explained. (See DMin 4605.)
The very house itself, or place itself, separates them...
All married partners who are merely natural are separated after death...
With those married partners who think of separation, friendship entirely departs; but with those who do not think of separation, the love (with such) remains in externals...
Spiritual cold... whence... at last with many separation as to bed, chamber, and house. Explained.
There are separations from the bed, and separations from the house... The causes of separation coincide with those of concubinage...
The first cause of lawful separation is vitiation of mind. Explained.
The second cause of lawful separation is vitiation of body. Explained.
The third cause of lawful separation is impotence before marriage. Explained.
All other puttings away... are separations; if another wife is married, alter these, adultery is committed.
To avoid such mischiefs, he must either simulate favour for his wife, or they must be separated as to the house.
Two (such married partners) are not separated by the death of one of them...
Honour cannot be separated from love; but love can be separated from honour.
The just causes of this concubinage are the just causes of separation from the bed. Explained.
There are also milder causes which... separate from the bed, but not from the house. Enumerated.
By these spheres, the good are separated from the evil.
Therefore (after death) the one is separated from the other; friend from friend, parent from children...
Those who have formed friendships of love (here) cannot be separated according to order like others...
This second Advent... is that the evil may be separated from the good... General article.
On separations from Societies.
a. Separation (between Hells). Representation.
The Dutch women are separate from their husbands. Explained.
How the evil are separated from the good there.
The separation of all things from the Divine. Signified, Explained.
The water of separation... = the truth of the natural man.
The separation of the good from the evil before the Last Judgment. Treated of. AE 418, Explained. AE 419, Explained. AE 425. AE 426. AE 426:4, Explained. AE 489:2. AE 493:2. AE 502:2. AE 504:18.
Unless the good were separated from the evil, before the evil are cast into Hell, both would perish. Explained.
This separation cannot be effected before the time of the Last Judgment. Signified. (in the parable of the tares.) AE 911:7.
a. Influx... and thence changes of state, and separations. Signified, Explained.
The conjunction of the Heavens with those who were to be separated from the evil. Signified, Explained. AE 497, Signified, Explained.
The wicked are to be separated from the upright before the Last Judgment comes, and also after it; and they are not separated except successively...
The interiors of the Word, etc., are (then) revealed, that the good may be separated from the evil. Explained.
In both worlds... there is a revelation, and a separation by it.
Separation, and thence protection. Signified, Explained.
Separation as to internals and their protection. Signified, Explained.
When the good were separated from them... their external good vanished.
The good convert themselves, and are thus separated.
When the evil have been separated from the good. Treated of. AE 691:end.
The higher Heavens in light and power to separate the evil from the good before the day of the Last Judgment... Signified, Explained.
The state of those in the former heaven... is changed through the separation of the good from the evil...
The conflict of their interiors with their exteriors in the first state of separation...
The presence of the Lord in Heaven and the Church to separate the good from the evil. Signified, Explained.
The separation of the good from the evil. Signified. (in .).
It treats (in ) of the separation of the good from the evil before the Last Judgment; and the good who have been separated from the evil are meant by the 144,000 sealed. AE 907.
The hour of His Judgment is come = the separation of those who live according to Divine truths...
A prediction about the separation of the good from the evil. Signified, Explained.
For visitation precedes separation; and after separation takes place the Last Judgment.
It is the time for collecting the good, and separating them from the evil. Signified, Explained. AE 912. Signified, Explained. AE 918.
That the separation of falsities of evil... cannot be effected until it is the last state of the Church. Signified.
The Second of redemption was the separation of the evil from the good.
